ovenConfigurations.name: Single-Deck Electric Forced-Air Impingement Conveyor (16 kW, 32" Belt)
ovenConfigurations.description: Standard single-belt commercial electric impingement oven; eliminates gas combustion byproducts but discharges high convective thermal plumes from entry and exit aperture portals.

ovenConfigurations.name: Double-Stack Commercial Gas Impingement Conveyor (2x 120,000 BTU/hr Natural Gas)
ovenConfigurations.description: Workhorse configuration for high-volume delivery pizzerias; dual modulating burners generate high thermal convective discharge and substantial combustion flue volume requiring balanced exhaust.

ovenConfigurations.name: Triple-Stack High-Volume Franchise Gas Impingement (3x 140,000 BTU/hr LP/NG)
ovenConfigurations.powerType: Natural Gas / Liquid Propane High Output
ovenConfigurations.description: Extreme commercial throughput configuration capable of 180+ large pizzas/hr; generates monumental buoyancy-driven convective plumes and massive flue gas mass flow.

ovenConfigurations.name: Ultra-High-Temperature Electric Quartz/Refractory Deck Conveyor (32 kW, 480°C / 900°F Neapolitan)
ovenConfigurations.description: Artisan high-speed conveyor reaching 900°F deck temperatures; zero gas burner emissions, but rapid crust pyrolysis creates severe particulate smoke and localized incomplete combustion from carbonizing dough.

ovenConfigurations.name: EPA Method 202 Ventless Catalytic Single-Deck Conveyor (18 kW Integral Recirculating Hood)
ovenConfigurations.powerType: Electric with Integral Catalyst & Electrostatic Precipitator
ovenConfigurations.description: Self-contained UL 710B / EPA 202 compliant oven; built-in catalytic scrubbers neutralize VOCs and grease vapors, but rejects 100% of sensible thermal energy directly into the conditioned kitchen space.

hoodVentilationTiers.name: Dedicated NFPA 96 Type I Hood (12" Overhang, 400 CFM/linear ft, Interlocked MUA)
hoodVentilationTiers.description: Complies fully with NFPA 96 Chapter 5 and IMC Section 507; deep 12-inch end overhangs capture high-velocity conveyor discharge plumes, maintaining optimal indoor air quality.

hoodVentilationTiers.name: Standard Type II Heat & Moisture Hood (6" Overhang, 220 CFM/linear ft, Neutral MUA)
hoodVentilationTiers.description: Permitted in certain jurisdictions for electric pizza ovens without fatty animal proteins; susceptible to thermal plume spillage under cross-drafts exceeding 50 FPM.

hoodVentilationTiers.name: Undersized / Retrofitted Canopy Hood (0" Overhang, 130 CFM/linear ft, Deficient MUA)
hoodVentilationTiers.description: Failed capture envelope; open conveyor portals discharge buoyant thermal plumes and burner combustion gases directly into line cook breathing zones.

hoodVentilationTiers.name: Unhooded / Severe Negative Room Pressure (Backdrafting Draft Hood)
hoodVentilationTiers.description: Gross life-safety violation; negative building pressure draws flue exhaust back through draft diverters into the kitchen, resulting in lethal carbon monoxide build-up.

flourParticulateAndFatLoads.name: Heavy Semolina / Cornmeal Dusting with Pepperoni, Sausage & Bacon Grease Spatter
flourParticulateAndFatLoads.description: Coarse cornmeal falls onto heating elements/crumb pans and pyrolyzes into dense smoke, while rendered pork fat generates aerosolized carcinogens.

flourParticulateAndFatLoads.name: Moderate Cornmeal Dusting with Whole-Milk Mozzarella & Veggies
flourParticulateAndFatLoads.description: Standard commercial pizzeria operating condition with routine cheese boiling and light cornmeal charring on lower catch pans.

flourParticulateAndFatLoads.name: Perforated Pizza Screen Baking (Zero Dusting Flour, Lean Flatbreads)
flourParticulateAndFatLoads.description: Clean baking technique utilizing oiled or seasoned wire mesh screens without loose flour, minimizing particulate suspension.

combustionAirConditions.name: Optimal Primary Air Shutter Adjustment (10.5:1 Air-to-Gas Ratio, Clean Blue Flames)
combustionAirConditions.description: Factory-calibrated burner with clean air intake filters and perfect stoichiometric gas-to-air combustion mixture.

combustionAirConditions.name: Partially Blocked Burner Venturi & Air Lint Screen (15% Oxygen Starvation)
combustionAirConditions.description: Flour dust, lint, and grease vapor coat the blower intake screen, reducing primary air and inducing incomplete combustion.

combustionAirConditions.name: Severely Clogged Combustion Air Blower / Dirty Orifice (30% Starvation, Yellow Lazy Flames)
combustionAirConditions.description: Critical burner failure state; insufficient secondary air causes heavy soot generation and dangerous carbon monoxide emission spikes.

operationalDutyCycles.name: Peak Friday Night Rush (100% Conveyor Deck Saturation, 6-Hour Continuous Run)
operationalDutyCycles.description: Maximum conveyor throughput with zero deck gaps; continuous radiant and convective thermal plume discharge.

operationalDutyCycles.name: Standard Weekday Lunch Service (60% Conveyor Capacity, 3-Hour Run)
operationalDutyCycles.description: Moderate commercial pace with periodic breaks between orders; stable thermal equilibrium under standard ventilation.

operationalDutyCycles.name: Continuous Idle Warm-Hold (0% Pizza Load, Open Air Draft Circulation)
operationalDutyCycles.description: Oven remains at baking temperature without dough loading; thermal convection chimneys through open portals continuously.
